facts.fact: 章首引语出自 1983 年电影 WarGames，回响在 2026 年 1 月一个清晨作者 Kenmore 书房
facts.anchor: The only winning move is not to play

facts.fact: 军事超算 WOPR 推演无数遍后得出：核冲突没有赢家
facts.anchor: in nuclear conflict, there are no winners

facts.fact: Arrival（2016，Denis Villeneuve）中十二艘外星飞船降临地球
facts.anchor: twelve alien spacecraft descend upon Earth

facts.fact: 外星人到来的不是征服而是礼物，他们需要人类如同人类需要他们
facts.anchor: Their survival, centuries hence, depends on humanity’s flourishing now.

facts.fact: 作者三十年（印度本科神经网络、加州人形机器人、推荐系统偏见幽灵）后总结的信念
facts.anchor: We are not at war with AI. We are raising it.

facts.fact: 大三口头考试时考官对作者「你的网络像人一样学习吗」的回应
作者从「无知」进步到「知道自己无知」——这也是一种进步
facts.anchor: I have moved from not knowing to knowing what I do not know

facts.fact: 结尾句：唯一的输法就是假装这场游戏不由我们塑造
facts.anchor: The only losing move is to pretend the game is not ours to shape.
